review.notes: All 12 physical pages compared word-by-word against the OCR Markdown; no code fences. All three footnote bodies were verified on 300 dpi bottom-strip crops of physical pages 1, 3 and 8. Remaining word-level differences are LaTeX math, soft-hyphen line breaks, and Figure 1 demo/label text that lives inside the embedded figure image. The PDF itself prints the typos 'tokenizater' (p.2), 'superivised fine-turning' and 'mutli-stage' (p.4 caption), and 'emothion' (p.8); OCR corrected some of them (kept 'fine-turning' and 'mutli-stage'); left unchanged per the no-author-typo-patch rule.
